rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: Under a case-record action dated 12 May 2016 the Senate recorded joining to volume 48 of the file a copy of the Mandado de Intimação issued to President Dilma Vana Rousseff (fl. 18.142) and the counterpart acknowledging its receipt signed by her (fl. 18.143), with the Mandado de Citação and its signed counterpart (fls. 18.144-18.145).

locator.section: Tramitação, entry dated 12/05/2016 ('Publicado no DSF Páginas 7-13 Suplemento (nº A)'), paragraph 'Ainda no volume 48, Termo de Juntada à fl.18.147', items 1-4

rows.role_title: Vice-President of the Republic in exercise of the office of President
rows.text: The same 12 May 2016 action records a copy of the Mandado de Notificação issued to Vice-President Michel Temer, signed by him on its face (fl. 18.146).

locator.section: Tramitação, entry dated 12/05/2016, 'Ainda no volume 48', item 5
